verdict.rationale: cubic documents an auto-resolve option that closes review threads once the issue is fixed (cubic-docs-20), which covers tracking fixes. Auto-fix refers to 'every review of a pull request' (cubic-docs-66), implying repeated reviews per PR. However, no evidence explicitly says pushing new commits triggers an incremental re-review or that old comments are deduplicated. Missing for 10: explicit docs that new commits trigger an incremental, diff-only re-review; documented suppression of repeated prior comments; independent or hands-on corroboration.
